continuity: Taekyung has spent more than two months undergoing increasingly severe training from Jeok Cheongang on Mount Jiuhua.
Taekyung completed Fire King's Hellfire Training-2, earned the Unmoving achievement, changed Toughness into Endurance, gained two levels, and received 50 Bonus Points.
Taekyung completed the first Fist-and-Foot Training repeat Quest; Strength, Stamina, and Agility each increased by 1, with additional rewards deferred until he learns related martial arts.
Jeok Cheongang's sleep has increased and he has displayed repeated forgetfulness; Taekyung recognizes these symptoms as dementia, while Jeok acknowledges suffering from the ailments of old age.
The Fire Gate Cavern is the place where the Fire Gate Clan began and where its legacy continues; seventeen urns of former Sect Leaders are arranged around a blue-white flame.
Entering the Fire Gate Cavern lifted the restriction on Taekyung's internal energy, which reacts strongly because it originated from the Blazing Flame Divine Pill.
Jeok Cheongang has chosen to transmit the Fire Gate Clan's martial arts to Taekyung, and Taekyung agreed because he trusts Jeok despite the danger posed by Jeok's memory loss.
The Heir of the Fire Gate Quest was created, and Jeok brought out the Fire Gate Divine Technique to begin Taekyung's instruction.
plot: Jeok Cheongang subjects Taekyung to increasingly brutal training on Mount Jiuhua, including waterfall horse stances, weighted push-ups, cliff climbing, and retrieving a swallow's nest. Taekyung completes Fire King's Hellfire Training-2, earns the Unmoving achievement, converts Toughness into Endurance, gains two levels and 50 Bonus Points, and continues training for more than two months.

Jeok's increasing sleep and memory lapses become undeniable when he forgets ordering Taekyung's fist-and-foot training. Taekyung asks whether he is ill, and Jeok leads him to a hidden place instead of answering directly.

Jeok brings Taekyung into the Fire Gate Cavern, explains the Fire Gate Clan's centuries-long history, and reveals its seventeen ancestral urns. The cavern releases the restriction on Taekyung's internal energy, and Jeok offers to pass on the clan's martial arts. Taekyung accepts because he trusts Jeok, generating the Heir of the Fire Gate Quest, but Jeok's confusion interrupts the first lesson. The two then vanish from Mount Jiuhua as the seasons change three times.
translation_decisions: Use Fire Gate Cavern for 열화동 and Heir of the Fire Gate for 열화의 계승자.
Preserve Fire King's Hellfire Training-2 as the source's distinct quest-title variant.
Use Fist-and-Foot Training for 권각 수련 and fist-and-foot martial arts for 권각술.

active_continuity: Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang are in Anhui at Mount Jiuhua for an extended period of extreme training.
Taekyung wears iron balls continuously; their chains are made from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, and the weights have continued increasing during training.
Taekyung completed the first mountain-climbing Quest after ten days, gained a level, and received 30 Bonus Points.
Jeok Cheongang imposed increasingly harsh repeatable training because he has limited time to teach Taekyung.
Jin Mukyung remains isolated in an unlit training cave, practicing ten thousand sword strikes without internal energy.
Hong Dao is the Abbot of Shaolin and the Murim's Dharma King, master of Unnamed, and an old friend of Jeok Cheongang.
Hong Dao identifies Taekyung as the Morning Star and foresees an unknowable calamity as the heavenly patterns become distorted.
Dark Heaven manipulated the Blade of Flowers for decades and restricted the Head Elder's surviving faction.
Namgung Ryong ordered the Namgung family's intelligence network to investigate Taekyung.
Taekyung and Cheongpung intend to attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet in one year.
Jeok Cheongang has suffered sudden weakness and believes he has little time.
Taekyung completed Fire King's Hellfire Training-2, earned Unmoving, changed Toughness into Endurance, gained two levels, and received 50 Bonus Points.
Taekyung completed the first Fist-and-Foot Training repeat Quest, increasing Strength, Stamina, and Agility by 1 each.
Jeok Cheongang's increasing sleep and memory lapses lead Taekyung to recognize dementia; Jeok takes him to the Fire Gate Cavern.
The Fire Gate Cavern contains seventeen urns of former Fire Gate Clan Sect Leaders around a blue-white flame and is the origin and continuing site of the clan's legacy.
The Fire Gate Cavern lifted the restriction on Taekyung's internal energy because it reacts to the Blazing Flame Divine Pill's origin.
Jeok Cheongang offered to transmit the Fire Gate Clan's martial arts, and Taekyung accepted because he trusts him.
The Heir of the Fire Gate Quest was created, and Jeok produced the Fire Gate Divine Technique for Taekyung's instruction.
Jeok's confusion interrupted the first lesson, after which he and Taekyung vanished from Mount Jiuhua as the seasons changed three times.
open_questions: How quickly will Jeok Cheongang's dementia progress, and how much time does he have to teach Taekyung?
Why has Namgung Ryong committed the family's intelligence network to investigating Taekyung?
What important matter does Jin Wikyung need to discuss privately with Jeok Cheongang?
Did Mae Jonghak actually grant Cheongpung permission to become Jeok's Disciple, and where is Mae now?
Will Baek Museong escort Cheongpung to Huashan or search the Central Plains for Mae Jonghak?
Will Jin Mukyung eventually attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet?
What is the unknowable calamity approaching as the heavenly patterns become distorted?
What does Dark Heaven intend, and how is it connected to the approaching calamity?

Use Huangshan Sect for 황산파 and Mountain Lord for 산주.
Use Namgung Ryong for 남궁룡 and Namgung for 남궁.
Use Pressure-Point Strike for 점혈 and Sleep Acupoint for 수혈.
Use Fire King's Special Restriction Pill for 화왕 특제 금제단.
Preserve the source's quest-title variants: 화왕의 불지옥 수련-1 is Fire King's Inferno Training-1, while 화왕의 지옥불 수련-1 is Fire King's Hellfire Training-1.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Over-one-hundred-year-old wandering martial master and the Fire King; he visits Jang Taebo’s home, can detect Qi Sense, can cross more than ten jang in an instant, plans to reach Taiyuan and visit the Lower District Sect while concealing his identity, and once fought Sword Saint Mae Jonghak for seven days and seven nights to a draw at Mount Jiuhua before emerging from seclusion and annihilating one thousand Demonic Cultists there; after striking Jin Taekyung with the Flame Divine Palm, he deduces that Taekyung took the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and confronts him when he tries to flee the inn; he reaches the Jin Family of Taiyuan, falsely identifies the Unnamed Sword in public as the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure entrusted to Taekyung, later reveals that it is actually the Fire Heaven Sword, the beloved sword of the Fire Gate Clan’s tenth Sect Leader, uses Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission to stop Song Il, publicly humiliates him, then follows the departing Zhongnan group, incapacitates the Three Hands, breaks Song Il’s wrist, strikes him with the Flame Divine Palm, and threatens to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Taekyung or the Jin Family is harmed; two days later, he severely beats Taekyung with his bare fists over the partly burned Flame Divine Palm manual, performs an abbreviated cleansing treatment on Taekyung, discovers his exceptionally balanced body, and suspects he may possess the legendary Heavenly Martial Physique; at the Jin Family banquet, after Ak Bulgun questions their relationship, he publicly declares himself the eighteenth Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, accepts Taekyung as his Disciple, and declares that Taekyung will inherit the clan’s orthodox lineage; he identifies Taekyung as possessing the Heavenly Martial Physique, agrees to personally oversee Taekyung’s martial-arts training until Taekyung reaches a certain level, and permits Taekyung to address him as Master publicly and Old Master in private while continuing to deny that they are truly master and Disciple; after accepting Taekyung’s challenge to defend only, he is forced five steps backward by Taekyung’s One Annihilation and admits defeat, then supports Taekyung with internal energy as he collapses; impressed by the strike, he now desires to guide Taekyung toward becoming a Heavenly Dragon; he successfully forces open Taekyung’s Conception and Governor Vessels, then carries the unconscious Taekyung away to rest after the ordeal; he waits through Taekyung’s seven-day unconscious recovery, explains that removing accumulated turbid qi caused the adjustment period, discusses the Star-Array Grand Banquet invitation, and asks Taekyung to visit his quarters at dawn after hearing Taekyung’s desire to pursue greater strength; he now takes Taekyung away immediately for a year of martial-arts training in Anhui; after the seven-day journey from Taiyuan to Luoyang, he effortlessly defeats Heukgeol and compels the Dongcheon Sect’s fighters to withdraw without killing them; after leaving Hong Dao’s residence, he reaches Mount Jiuhua in Anhui with Taekyung after a fifteen-day forced march and plans to impose six months of extreme training; he uses Seizing an Object Through Empty Space to pull Taekyung back, strikes his Sleep Acupoint with Pressure-Point Strike to force him to sleep for two shichen, then suffers a sudden bout of weakness after expending too much strength and acknowledges that he has little time while carrying Taekyung toward Mount Jiuhua.
